name: Jira
covers: Issues, search, transitions, comments, worklogs, attachments, custom fields, projects, users, boards, sprints
credential: Personal access token (Data Center) or Atlassian account email and API token (Cloud)
credentialWhere: Data Center: your profile picture → Profile → Personal Access Tokens. Cloud: id.atlassian.com → Security → API tokens

supported.api: REST API 2 and Agile REST API 1.0
supported.note: toil authenticates to Data Center with a personal access token, which Jira Data Center added in 8.14. No release has been verified yet. Jira Cloud (a connection with deployment cloud) is always current: toil calls REST API 3 (/rest/api/3, with the enhanced JQL search at /rest/api/3/search/jql) and the Agile REST API 1.0, with an Atlassian account email and API token sent as Basic auth. Nothing has been run against a live Cloud site yet.

credentialNote: One area for both: a Cloud connection sets deployment to cloud and an email, sent as Basic auth with the token. Both deployments are verified at the unit level, so the board shows one
